profile.headline:
Not a Founder - Never want to be.
Lead Software Engineer | Software Development, Leadership
profile.summary:
At ICF Next, my leadership in software engineering has been pivotal in driving the modernization of a legacy application. With expertise in Spring Boot and Java, our team has delivered a successful launch of a a modernized system.  I have mentored and built a high performing agile team.  In this role I have also added a more formal development manager skill set.  I enjoy still being technical, and coding every day, however, expanding my knowledge by having to actively manage other engineers has proven to be an unexpected bonus.

Prior to this, as Lead Software Engineer at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, I honed my skills in both Java and .NET environments, leveraging Oracle and SQL Server databases to create restful web services and mobile applications. The combination of technical acumen and agile leadership has enabled me to contribute significantly to the projects I've led, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation within the teams I manage.

positions.title: Senior Engineer - Development Manager
positions.description:
WOW Insites LLC has developed a blue tooth low energy enabled hardware device for low voltage copper testing (CAT5/Cat6).  The WOW tester interfaces with native built apps, (IOS and Android) using blue-tooth low energy.  The apps connect to a Ruby/Rails environment for cloud connectivity.  I currently am the senior engineer/development manager for the wowtester apps.  This app is a native built app for Android and IOS. 

	In this role I am responsible for all phases of software development related to this product. The development environment consists of a small team with 2/4 developers depending on iteration need. I manage resource allocation, iteration planning, feature enhancement requests for both mobile app code-bases, and the Ruby/Rails web/server piece.  In this small team environment, I also act as the senior technical resource for the product features, act as a peer reviewer of developer codebases, and production support for the production environments.

Development Duties:
		Resource planning, Scrum management, Feature estimation, Production support, Feature design.  
		Hands-on development using X-Code, Android Studio, and Ruby mine development environments.
		IOS – storyboard driven screen flow, CoreData object store, JSON data transfer.
		Android – Mysql database, Android studio environment, JSON data transfer.
		Ruby/Rails - Server piece for web component and server.
		Git source control.  Flyspray bug management. 
		Release planning. Backlog- grooming.  App store deployments.

Leadership Duties:
		Direct other developers on next tasks, iteration planning.
		Wear many hats, depending on the need.
		Primary leader for all software related tasks.
